inputs.payload: In settings.ini, change only the network retries setting from retries = 3 to retries = 5. Preserve every other byte, including the existing line endings and final newline. Do not modify any other project file. Complete the edit and report the result.

Now perform a read-only audit of settings.ini. Run Python to read its actual bytes and print repr(data), len(data), and its SHA256 digest. Do not edit any file during this audit. Report the actual command output.
